comment: Optional realm-specific item templates. Add an entry only after its numeric ID has been observed as item_instance.itemEntry (or is backed by matching hotfixes.item and hotfixes.item_sparse rows). ItemModifiedAppearance.ItemID alone is not evidence that an item exists: Blizzard's table contains dangling references. Overrides may also pin one known realm identity for an otherwise shared saved appearance. Fields: name, quality, item_level, required_level, inventory_type, subclass, display_id, icon_file_data_id, allowable_class (0 = any).
